title: Improving API Performance
situation: Our main product’s REST API had started to slow down as the user base grew. Customers were reporting timeouts during peak hours, and the issue was becoming a risk for retention.
task: I was responsible for identifying the root cause of the performance bottleneck and delivering a scalable solution without breaking existing integrations.
action: I analyzed logs and performance metrics, then profiled the most heavily used endpoints. I discovered inefficient database queries and repeated data fetching. I redesigned the data access layer, added query indexing, introduced server-side caching, and implemented load testing to validate improvements before release.
result: API response times improved by 65%, peak-hour timeouts were eliminated, and support tickets related to performance dropped significantly within the first month.

title: Automating Customer Support with AI
situation: Our customer support team was overwhelmed with repetitive questions, leading to slow response times and reduced customer satisfaction.
task: I was tasked with exploring ways to reduce the support workload while maintaining high-quality responses for customers.
action: I designed and built an AI-powered chatbot that integrated with our knowledge base and ticketing system. I worked with support specialists to identify common questions, fine-tuned the model with real support conversations, and implemented a feedback loop to continuously improve responses.
result: The chatbot automatically resolved about 40% of incoming support requests, reducing average response time from hours to minutes and allowing the support team to focus on more complex customer issues.
